build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: __now when available; otherwise Date.now. Calibration >=50ms, median of seven samples.
order: Three complete 33-case invocations per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 297 values checked. All FormatJS before/after values match. Only comparator differences: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Serialize validated enum and Unicode-type option strings directly. Removes generic record serializer, key arrays and temporary option-value record. Preserves locale resolution before style/numeric getters. Locale and query string quoting retained.

conformance.gates: Seven targeted Hermes source/bytecode, Test262, types and pinned ICU4C/J/X checks pass.
conformance.independentMatrix: Inherited pinned 19,008-case ICU4X relative-time matrix, including 1,440 individually pinned separator differences verified by ICU4C/J 78.1.
conformance.observableBehavior: Malformed numbering-system strings with quotes, backslashes, newlines, NUL and lone surrogates reject before style getter. Getter-time registration, coercion and prototype cases retain existing coverage.
conformance.consumer: Nine SDK API smoke scripts pass.

limits: Other constructor and steady-state gaps remain. No whole-goal completion claim.

commands.benchmark: bazel build -c opt //benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension:overlap_bytecode; run cquery artifact on each pinned optimized host
